__comment: Every 'y' is gone on purpose. The receiver renders as ENTITYBLOCK_ANIMATED so the VU meters can move, which means Minecraft never consults rotation here - ReceiverBlockEntityRenderer applies it as rotation * 360/16. This file used to carry real y values; they stopped doing anything the moment the render shape changed, and leaving them would invite someone to 'fix' a rotation bug here and see no effect. Same trap the speaker blockstates have.
